qualification: S7 Blocked (NOT Production Qualified). Both Ubuntu 22.04 Humble and Ubuntu 24.04 Jazzy release packages, relocated out-of-tree SDK replays, multi-stream ROS2->MCAP + ros2 bag info, 2x consecutive SIGKILL recovery, mid-download disconnect ReadLease x Reset, WEB-E2E-018 1Hz DOM/heap stability, and multi-browser Chrome/Edge/Firefox E2E all passed locally. External 72h/168h endurance, target industrial hardware/power-loss, native macOS Safari 16.4, and remote GitHub CI remain required before declaring RoDAQ V1 Production Qualified.
